note: What a server sends once a client has said which build it runs: whether the two agree, which map to load, who is at the match, and everything else settled before play. The header names no object: it carries zero.

bits.name: buildMatches
bits.note: Set where the client's build is one the server serves.

bits.name: reportsToFile
bits.note: Set to have a client also write its reports to a file of its own, where it reports by the older means (features bit 18 clear).

bits.name: matched
bits.note: Set where the match was put together rather than made by hand.

bits.name: reportingReady
bits.note: Set where the reporting settings below are to be used.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: Bit 4 is set aside for the scripted voice-over system, which a client takes from its own settings instead; a client reads none of these.

fields.name: map
fields.note: Which map to load. spec/movement.md keys the path origins by the same maps.

fields.name: seats
fields.note: Every place at the match, held or empty.

fields.name: build
fields.note: Which build the server serves. Written out in full and padded with zero bytes to the width above.

fields.name: mode
fields.note: Which way the match is played, written and padded as above.

fields.name: platform
fields.note: Which platform the match belongs to, written and padded as above.

fields.name: variants
fields.note: The variations the match is played under, one place each. A place stands empty where none applies.

items.name: variant
items.note: One variation. Written out in full and padded with zero bytes to the width above.

fields.name: variantCount
fields.note: How many of the places above are filled.

fields.name: teamName
fields.note: What one side is called where it plays as a standing team, written and padded as above.

fields.name: teamTag
fields.note: The short form of that name, written and padded as above.

fields.name: otherTeamName
fields.note: What the other side is called, under the same terms.

fields.name: otherTeamTag
fields.note: The short form of that one.

fields.name: metricsHost
fields.note: Where a client reports figures about the match, written and padded as above.

fields.name: metricsPath
fields.note: What it asks for there, written and padded as above.

fields.name: metricsPort
fields.note: Which port it reaches that at.

fields.name: reportingHost
fields.note: Where a client reports how the match went, written and padded as above.

fields.name: reportingPath
fields.note: What it asks for there, written and padded as above.

fields.name: reportingPort
fields.note: Which port it reaches that at.

fields.name: altReportingHost
fields.note: A second, test place to report to, written and padded as above.

fields.name: altReportingPath
fields.note: What it asks for there, written and padded as above.

fields.name: altReportingPort
fields.note: Which port it reaches that at.

fields.name: tip
fields.note: Which note the client shows before play.

fields.name: tipColour
fields.note: Which colouring it shows it in.

fields.name: tipDuration
fields.note: Which of the display times in the client's own settings to hold the note up for, read only where tips are enabled and shown somewhere. tip, tipColour and tipDuration each name an entry; a client takes tip modulo its number of tips, and an entry missing (or a time not above zero) is an error, negated and tips cleared, returned so in ClientReady.

fields.name: tipFlags
fields.note: How the note is shown. A client sends these four bytes back in ClientReady, as it has corrected them.

bits.name: enabled
bits.note: Set where there is a note. A client builds it only where this and loadingScreen or inGame are set, and clears this, negating the bad figure, where tip, tipColour or tipDuration names nothing.

bits.name: replay
bits.note: Of no effect; a client clears it, with enabled, while playing a replay.

bits.name: loadingScreen
bits.note: Set to show the note on the loading screen.

bits.name: inGame
bits.note: Set to show the note during play, in a box on the screen.

bits.name: cycle
bits.note: Set to have the box during play show every note in turn.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: A client does not read these.

fields.name: features
fields.note: Which parts of the match are turned on, one bit each. A client takes all of them as they come; all clear, it notes so in its log.

bits.name: balanceVoteCommands
bits.note: The chat commands /equalize and /noequalize.

bits.name: menuBack
bits.note: With menuBack2, a second key that closes the pause and options menu. Alone, the minimap's showing of neutral camps follows the player's settings rather than the minimap's own.

bits.name: menuBack2
bits.note: Of use only with menuBack.

bits.name: quickChat
bits.note: Quick chat: its keys and its panel.

bits.name: missileWarning
bits.note: A missile coming at the client's side, or at no one, may show before it leaves the fog where it is near for its speed and heading that way.

bits.name: animatedCursors
bits.note: Cursors of several frames move on a frame every 0.15 seconds of play; clear, they show their first frame.

bits.name: shopUndo
bits.note: The shop's undo; clear, it is never enabled.

bits.name: bit7
bits.note: Read only in laying out the options menu.

bits.name: skillshotOutline
bits.note: While aiming a line spell, the units it would hit are outlined.

bits.name: championIndicator
bits.note: The mark over the player's champion, where their own setting also asks for it.

bits.name: altBounty
bits.note: Another reckoning of kill and assist gold: kill gold and the assist pool grow with time, a run of assists adds gold, and assists and minion gold shorten a run of deaths.

bits.name: bit11
bits.note: Read only in laying out the options menu.

bits.name: turretRange
bits.note: Enemy turrets' ranges, where the player's setting also asks for them; clear, they are never drawn.

bits.name: bit13
bits.note: Read only in laying out the options menu.

bits.name: skinParticles
bits.note: Skin-specific particle effects for units in a skin other than the first.

bits.name: networkMetrics
bits.note: Reports of network figures from time to time, where reporting is on (agreement's reportingReady).

bits.name: hardwareMetrics
bits.note: A report of hardware and frame rate at the end of the match.

bits.name: lagMetrics
bits.note: Lag figures in the network report.

bits.name: eventReports
bits.note: Reports go by the newer, event-based means; clear, by the older one.

bits.name: logServerAddress
bits.note: A client writes the server's address and its own command line to its log.

bits.name: jungleTimers
bits.note: Timers for the jungle camps on the screen.

bits.name: traceroute
bits.note: A trace of the route to the server, begun after this message and reported later, where reporting is on.

bits.name: bit22
bits.note: Read only in laying out the options menu.

bits.name: bit23
bits.note: Read only in laying out the options menu.

bits.name: bit24
bits.note: Read only in laying out the options menu.

bits.name: clockSync
bits.note: The game's clock is nudged to keep with the system's at normal speed; in a replay, play follows the game's clock.

bits.name: bit26
bits.note: Read only in laying out the options menu.

bits.name: farmBounty
bits.note: Kill gold also counts assists and minion gold, and a death scales runs down rather than clearing them.

bits.name: turretsPersist
bits.note: Turrets stay as objects after they are destroyed.

bits.name: stateFlags
bits.note: A unit's can-move, can-attack, can-cast and like states are set on or off rather than counted up and down.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: A client does not read these.

bits.name: unusedHigh
bits.note: A client does not read these.

fields.name: disabledItems
fields.note: Items nobody may buy in this match, one place each. A place holds zero where nothing is barred.

items.name: item
items.note: One item, by the number the client knows it as.

fields.name: reportingMessages
fields.note: Which of the reports a client sends are wanted, one place each, in this order: game start, game end, ping use, chat filter, damage figures, active item figures, network figures, hardware figures, server debugging, client debugging, item shop, injected modules, suspicious behaviour, skin swaps, failure to connect, traceroute, network instrumentation, peer network instrumentation, and block builder logging. A client takes any nonzero byte as wanted; a zero does not turn a report off.

bits.name: buildMatches
bits.note: Set where the client's build is one the server serves.

bits.name: unknown1
bits.note: Purpose undetermined. Observed clear.

bits.name: matched
bits.note: Set where the match was put together rather than made by hand.

bits.name: reportingReady
bits.note: Set where the reporting settings below are to be used.

bits.name: unknown
bits.note: Observed clear.

fields.name: variantCount
fields.note: How many of the places above are filled.

fields.name: teamTag

fields.name: otherTeamName
fields.note: What the other side is called, under the same terms.

fields.name: otherTeamTag
fields.note: The short form of that one.

fields.name: metricsHost
fields.note: Where a client reports figures about the match, written and padded as above.

fields.name: metricsPath
fields.note: What it asks for there, written and padded as above.

fields.name: metricsPort
fields.note: Which port it reaches that at.

fields.name: reportingHost
fields.note: Where a client reports how the match went, written and padded as above.

fields.name: reportingPath
fields.note: What it asks for there, written and padded as above.

fields.name: reportingPort
fields.note: Which port it reaches that at.

fields.name: altReportingHost
fields.note: A second such place, written and padded as above.

fields.name: altReportingPath
fields.note: What it asks for there, written and padded as above.

fields.name: altReportingPort
fields.note: Which port it reaches that at.

fields.name: tip
fields.note: Which note the client shows before play.

fields.name: tipColour
fields.note: Which colouring it shows it in.

fields.name: tipDuration
fields.note: How long it holds the note up. What the figure counts is not recorded here.

fields.name: tipFlags
fields.note: How else it shows it. The bits within are undetermined.
